stem: An analyst's last-click report gives display retargeting far more credit than expected. Many customers clicked a retargeting ad in the days after they ordered. What is the most likely fault in the query?

options.text: Touches after the order were kept, so a later click became the last touch
The lookback window was too short, so the earlier touches all dropped out
Orders with no touch were credited to an unattributed row of their own
Each order's revenue was split evenly over every touch in its path
